review-us-sign-maker: Choose We are listening, Enjoyed your visit, How did we do or the Hindi starter. A starter sets the colours and the wording, and you can change every line later.
Add your name and review link

Type your business name and paste your Google review link. The QR code opens your review box. Add an address or phone line if you like. Until you add a link, the QR code shows a sample address, so do not print yet.

The preview updates as you type. Under More options you can change the lines, choose another colour and border, add a small logo above your name, and turn on a star rating and review count with your real figures.

Choose the stand-up tent, a frame size or four small signs on one A4, then make the PDF or picture. Print at Actual size, cut along the marks, fold on the dashed line and scan it with your phone before you put it on the counter.

reviewSignGuide.title: Review Us Sign Maker: Print a Scan-to-Review QR Sign for Your Counter
reviewSignGuide.subtitle: Make a scan-to-review sign with a QR code to your Google review link, as a stand-up tent card or a frame sign. Free, no sign-up, nothing uploaded.
faq: Is the Review Us Sign Maker free?
Yes. It is free, with no sign-up, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it. The sign is made on your own device.
Where do I find my Google review link?

Open your Google Business Profile and look for the option to get more reviews or share a review form. Copy the link it shows and paste it into the tool. The names of the buttons can change over time, so look for the one that gives you a short link for customers.
How does the stand-up tent work?

The tent layout prints two strips on one A4 page. Cut along the marks, fold each strip on the dashed line and stand it on the counter. The back half is printed upside down on purpose, so both faces read upright and both QR codes work.
Yes. Under More options, choose a logo and it appears small in the centre, above your business name. Without a logo the sign is text only. A PNG with a clear background looks best.
Should I show a star rating and review count?
It is optional and off by default. If you turn it on, type only the real figures from your Google page and update them when they change. A sign with old or made-up numbers can mislead customers.
Can I offer a discount or a gift for a review?

Google asks businesses not to offer rewards in exchange for reviews, and to invite reviews from all customers, not only happy ones. Keep the sign simple and honest, and check Google's current rules for your business.
Will the QR code scan from a printout?

Yes, when it is printed at a reasonable size on clean paper. The code is dark on a white tile with a quiet margin, so it reads on every colour theme. Always scan the printed sign with your phone before you display it.
Are my details uploaded or saved on a server?

No. The business name, link and logo stay on your device and the sign is made in your browser. {{siteName}} does not receive them. Your last settings are remembered on this device only, and Start again clears them.

sections.heading: What the Review Us Sign Maker does
paragraphs: The Review Us Sign Maker turns your Google review link into a printed sign with a QR code. A customer points their phone at it and lands on your review box in a few seconds. It suits cafes, salons, clinics, hotels, shops and any place with a counter or table.
Pick a starter, add your business name and link, and the preview shows the sign at once. You can add an address, a small logo and, if you want, a star rating with the number of reviews.

sections.heading: Getting a sign that works
paragraphs: Print on clean paper at Actual size, and keep the QR code large and flat. Avoid glossy lamination that reflects light, because glare is the most common reason a code will not scan. Test it with two different phones before you put it out.
Use the stand-up tent for counters and tables, and the A5 or A4 size for a frame on a wall. The four-in-one page is handy for handing a small sign to each branch or table.

sections.heading: Private, honest reviews
paragraphs: Everything is made on your device, so your link and logo are not uploaded. The tool only draws the sign and the QR code.
Ask every customer for a review in the same way, and do not offer gifts or discounts for them. Real, mixed reviews are more trusted than a wall of perfect ones.
